_comment: SHARED known CI failure causes, matched deterministically before any model is asked. VENDORED BYTE-IDENTICAL across every repo — canonical copy lives in ai-standards/scripts/. Do NOT add repo-specific rows here; they belong in that repo's .ci-known-causes.json, which is unioned with this file. Every entry was diagnosed and fixed for real: a speculative signature is a confident wrong answer waiting to happen. Adding a row is data, not code.

_fields.id: stable key, referenced in the ledger and in eval
_fields.match: ALL of these substrings must appear in the log (case-insensitive)
_fields.not_match: if ANY of these appear, this is not the cause — guards against a near-miss claiming a match
_fields.cause: what is actually wrong, in one sentence
_fields.fix: the confirmed remedy — what a human should DO
_fields.confidence: high = seen and fixed; medium = seen once, fix inferred
_fields.same_line: require all `match` terms on ONE line. Use when the same rule appears in both a PASS and a FAIL line — whole-log matching cannot tell them apart.

causes.cause: A markdown link points at a SIBLING repo. It resolves on a developer's disk and never in CI, which clones this repo alone.
causes.fix: Not a defect. check_links reports these as OUTSIDE THIS REPO; if one still fails, the link escaped the repo without being caught by that rule.

causes.cause: A formatter wants to rewrite a VENDORED file that must stay byte-identical to its upstream copy.
causes.fix: Exclude the vendored path from the formatter (e.g. ruff extend-exclude). Reformatting it makes the drift check fight the formatter forever.

match: FROM requires either one or three arguments
causes.cause: A digest-pinned FROM line has a trailing # comment; Docker parses it as arguments.
causes.fix: Move the comment to its own line above the FROM.

causes.cause: A pinned GitHub Action version does not exist.
causes.fix: Check the real tags. Prefer a pinned container image over a third-party Action in a security pipeline — fewer moving parts to trust.

causes.cause: gitleaks is installed but the scan fell back to built-in patterns — the bridge is calling a CLI shape gitleaks no longer has.
causes.fix: gitleaks v8.19+ replaced detect/protect with dir/git and made the source positional. Check run_gitleaks() in scripts/pii_scan.py.

causes.cause: A job's `permissions:` block REPLACES the default scope set rather than adding to it, so listing any scope silently removes every scope not listed.
causes.fix: Add the scope the step actually needs back to the block — `actions: read` for `gh run view`. Least privilege is right; just remember the block is a full replacement, not a delta.
causes._note: Diagnosed by the diagnostician's own first real run (PR #3), which is the promotion loop working as designed.

match: no lines matched the failure heuristics
causes.cause: A job tried to read its OWN run's archived log. The run is still in progress while that job executes, so `gh run view --log-failed` returns something non-empty but useless rather than the failure.
causes.fix: Fetch per-JOB logs instead: list the run's jobs, select conclusion==failure, and GET repos/{repo}/actions/jobs/{id}/logs. An individual job's log is available as soon as that job finishes.
